responsibility: Implements the analyzer helper that linearizes a GCC RECORD_TYPE into an ordered sequence of fields and padding segments. By walking TYPE_FIELDS, computing each FIELD_DECL’s bit position and size, and inserting synthetic padding items between fields and at the end of the record, this file gives diagnostics and layout-sensitive analyses a way to query which field or padding occupies a given bit offset and to dump the resulting structure layout.
same_name_distinction: Contains the executable logic for record_layout declared in record-layout.h: it walks RECORD_TYPE fields, synthesizes padding items, builds the item vector, and implements dumping and offset lookup over that constructed layout.
